_doc: Kurisko Quad Rotation v0 parameters (krown format). label SOURCED = his words, quote + char offset in extracts/processed/kurisko/QUAD_ROTATION.md (S8) or KURISKO_SPEC s3 row; OURS = judgement, variants count in the trial ledger; OPERATOR-HYPOTHESIS = not Kurisko. enabled stays false: alert-only, no live wiring.

bands.label: OURS
bands.source: (k, d) fast first. Lookbacks 9, 14, 40, 60 are SOURCED; smoothing d=4 for third band is OURS adopted default from slide S4 (KURISKO_SPEC s5 row 1). Third band sensitivity tuple is (44,4) per KURISKO_SPEC s5 row 1 (reconciled from (44,3); ledger trial variant only).

bands_labels.label: OURS
bands_labels.source: Lookback 40 SOURCED R1 ('These are 40 candles and these are 60 candles', char 21291); smoothing d=4 is OURS adopted default from rehosted slide S4 (not in spoken words; KURISKO_SPEC s5 gap 1). Sensitivity tuple (44,4) documented in KURISKO_SPEC s5 row 1 as a sensitivity run in the ledger.

bands_labels.label: SOURCED
bands_labels.source: KURISKO_SPEC s3 row Stochastic 4 (S4 Full Stoch (60,10,10); S3 (60,10); R1 '60 candles') with d=10

line.label: SOURCED
line.source: R8 'here I'm using the D line. And the D line is the signal line'; D = SMA_d(raw %K) per spec_review_kurisko_2026-10-18.md FIX (FORMULAS s24). Slowing variant (60,10,10) = slow 10 + d 10 is a ledger trial.

level_lo.label: SOURCED
level_lo.source: R2 'all of these bands get oversold below 20' (char 20846); KURISKO_SPEC s3 Levels (S4, S2)

level_hi.label: SOURCED
level_hi.source: KURISKO_SPEC s3 Levels 20/80 (S4, S2); used only by the short mirror here

turn_rule.value: fast[t] > fast[t-1], all four < level_lo on s..t-1, one event per episode
turn_rule.label: OURS
turn_rule.source: no source defines the number for 'turn back up' (R3 'visual confirmation', KURISKO_SPEC s5 gap 3); other turn rules (D9 crosses up through 20) are ledger trials, not built

short_side.value: all four > level_hi and fast falls
short_side.label: OURS
short_side.source: NO-SOURCE: he never states 'all four above 80' (KURISKO_SPEC s5 gap 6, R10 only says the same goes for the downside); reported apart from the long arm

rsi_bands.label: OPERATOR-HYPOTHESIS
rsi_bands.source: operator memory '4 RSI with params'; 'RSI' occurs 0 times in S8 (KURISKO_SPEC s4); Wilder RSI via rsi_core on the same four lookbacks, levels 20/80 reused, NOT Kurisko
